scope: Prevent pokesleep-tool import semantics from changing unresolved scanner values while preserving all scanner rows and never auto-filling unresolved values.

observedSemantics: Blank pokemon field is skipped silently by BoxImporter.
For non-mythical Pokemon, blank ingredient 2 is not an unknown state: slot2 falls to B; blank ingredient 3 falls to A.
For mythical Pokemon, blank ingredient cells become undefined mythIng values, so unresolved blank cannot be distinguished from an intentional no-food value.
Blank subskill is accepted as null.
BoxExporter serializes internal unknown ingredient as an empty CSV cell.
CSV escaping and LF row separators remain aligned with CsvFormatter/BoxExporter.

app.js: Added csvCompatibilityBlockers() before both CSV save and copy.
CSV is blocked when species is unresolved or any food slot is unresolved/blank/invalid for explicit no-food semantics.
Confirmed mythical no-food `―` remains allowed only in slots permitted by classifier profiles and still serializes as an empty ingredient cell.
Unsafe blocker dialog explicitly states that rows are not deleted and values are not auto-filled.
Non-blocking warnings remain for nickname review, blank subskills, and in-progress manual edits.
Centralized the fixed 16-column conversion in toPokesleepToolCsvRow().
changes.rowPolicy: No result row is filtered or deleted. CSV build still maps every result to exactly one 16-column row once preflight passes.

validation.pokesleepCsvRoundTrip: passed via development/candidate48_pokesleep_csv_roundtrip.mjs using actual Candidate 48 serializer/preflight function source
roundTripCases: unresolved mythical food blocks until explicitly confirmed as ― or a food

saved100DiagnosticPreflightReplay.result: preflight blocks export instead of silently reinterpreting those 9 unresolved food slots
